name: sysDescr
description: Vendor and model description reported by the controller.

name: sysObjectID
description: Vendor object identifier; expected to remain stable for this controller family.

name: sysUpTime
description: Time since the SNMP management subsystem was initialized. A decrease normally indicates a controller or SNMP subsystem restart.

name: sysContact
description: Administrative contact configured on the controller.

name: sysName
description: Administrative DNS-style name configured on the controller.

name: sysLocation
description: Physical plant, building, or cabinet location configured on the controller.

name: ifDescr[1]

name: ifDescr[2]
description: Controller description of this network interface. Interface index 2.

name: ifDescr[3]
description: Controller description of this network interface. Interface index 3.

name: ifDescr[4]
description: Controller description of this network interface. Interface index 4.

name: ifSpeed[1]
description: Nominal interface bandwidth. Zero may mean the switch port is currently not linked. Interface index 1.

name: ifSpeed[2]
description: Nominal interface bandwidth. Zero may mean the switch port is currently not linked. Interface index 2.

name: ifSpeed[3]
description: Nominal interface bandwidth. Zero may mean the switch port is currently not linked. Interface index 3.

name: ifSpeed[4]
description: Nominal interface bandwidth. Zero may mean the switch port is currently not linked. Interface index 4.

name: ifAdminStatus[1]
description: Configured administrative interface state. Interface index 1.

name: ifAdminStatus[2]
description: Configured administrative interface state. Interface index 2.

name: ifAdminStatus[3]
description: Configured administrative interface state. Interface index 3.

name: ifAdminStatus[4]
description: Configured administrative interface state. Interface index 4.

name: ifOperStatus[1]
description: Current operational interface state. Alert only on ports expected to be connected. Interface index 1.

name: ifOperStatus[2]
description: Current operational interface state. Alert only on ports expected to be connected. Interface index 2.

name: ifOperStatus[3]
description: Current operational interface state. Alert only on ports expected to be connected. Interface index 3.

name: ifOperStatus[4]
description: Current operational interface state. Alert only on ports expected to be connected. Interface index 4.

name: ifLastChange[1]
description: sysUpTime value when the interface last changed operational state. Interface index 1.

name: ifLastChange[2]
description: sysUpTime value when the interface last changed operational state. Interface index 2.

name: ifLastChange[3]
description: sysUpTime value when the interface last changed operational state. Interface index 3.

name: ifLastChange[4]
description: sysUpTime value when the interface last changed operational state. Interface index 4.

name: ifInOctets[1]
description: Total octets received. This 32-bit counter can wrap and should be processed as a counter. Interface index 1.

name: ifInOctets[2]
description: Total octets received. This 32-bit counter can wrap and should be processed as a counter. Interface index 2.

name: ifInOctets[3]
description: Total octets received. This 32-bit counter can wrap and should be processed as a counter. Interface index 3.

name: ifInOctets[4]
description: Total octets received. This 32-bit counter can wrap and should be processed as a counter. Interface index 4.

name: ifInDiscards[1]
description: Received packets discarded without a detected packet error, for example because of resource pressure. Interface index 1.

name: ifInDiscards[2]
description: Received packets discarded without a detected packet error, for example because of resource pressure. Interface index 2.

name: ifInDiscards[3]
description: Received packets discarded without a detected packet error, for example because of resource pressure. Interface index 3.

name: ifInDiscards[4]
description: Received packets discarded without a detected packet error, for example because of resource pressure. Interface index 4.

name: ifInErrors[1]
description: Received packets containing errors. Sustained increases can indicate cabling, port, or EMC problems. Interface index 1.

name: ifInErrors[2]
description: Received packets containing errors. Sustained increases can indicate cabling, port, or EMC problems. Interface index 2.

name: ifInErrors[3]
description: Received packets containing errors. Sustained increases can indicate cabling, port, or EMC problems. Interface index 3.

name: ifInErrors[4]
description: Received packets containing errors. Sustained increases can indicate cabling, port, or EMC problems. Interface index 4.

name: ifOutOctets[1]
description: Total octets transmitted. This 32-bit counter can wrap and should be processed as a counter. Interface index 1.

name: ifOutOctets[2]
description: Total octets transmitted. This 32-bit counter can wrap and should be processed as a counter. Interface index 2.

name: ifOutOctets[3]
description: Total octets transmitted. This 32-bit counter can wrap and should be processed as a counter. Interface index 3.

name: ifOutOctets[4]
description: Total octets transmitted. This 32-bit counter can wrap and should be processed as a counter. Interface index 4.

name: ifOutDiscards[1]
description: Outbound packets discarded without a detected packet error. Interface index 1.

name: ifOutDiscards[2]
description: Outbound packets discarded without a detected packet error. Interface index 2.

name: ifOutDiscards[3]
description: Outbound packets discarded without a detected packet error. Interface index 3.

name: ifOutDiscards[4]
description: Outbound packets discarded without a detected packet error. Interface index 4.

name: ifOutErrors[1]
description: Outbound packets that could not be transmitted because of errors. Interface index 1.

name: ifOutErrors[2]
description: Outbound packets that could not be transmitted because of errors. Interface index 2.

name: ifOutErrors[3]
description: Outbound packets that could not be transmitted because of errors. Interface index 3.

name: wioArticleName
description: WAGO article number reported by the controller.

name: wioArticleDescription
description: WAGO product-family description reported by the controller.

name: wioSerialNumber
description: Controller serial and hardware identity string. Treat this as asset-identification data.

name: wioFirmwareIndex
description: Vendor firmware revision index used for asset and compatibility tracking.

name: wioHardwareIndex
description: Vendor hardware revision index used for asset tracking.

name: wioFwlIndex
description: Revision index of the firmware-loader software.

name: wioFirmwareVersion
description: Complete human-readable controller firmware version.

name: wioRtcBatteryStatus
description: Real-time-clock backup battery condition. A value of 1 means the battery is empty.

name: wioErrorGroup
description: Current WAGO diagnostic error group. Interpret together with error code, argument, and description.

name: wioErrorCode
description: Current WAGO diagnostic error code. Zero was observed while the controller reported normal operation.

name: wioErrorArgument
description: Additional argument for the current WAGO diagnostic error.

name: wioErrorDescription
description: Human-readable current WAGO diagnostic status or error description.

name: wioProjectId
description: Numeric identifier of the loaded CODESYS project; a change can indicate a new download.

name: wioProjectName
description: Name of the loaded CODESYS project.

name: wioProjectVersion
description: Version string stored in the loaded CODESYS project. It may be empty if the project does not define one.

name: wioIecTaskName[1]
description: Configured name of this IEC task.

name: wioIecTaskStatus[1]
description: Current IEC task status. The vendor MIB does not define numeric RUN/STOP meanings; observe controlled RUN and STOP states before creating a trigger.

name: wioIecTaskMode[1]
description: Current IEC task mode. The vendor MIB does not define the numeric meanings.

name: wioIecTaskCycleTime[1]
description: Most recent execution cycle time for this IEC task; the vendor MIB does not specify the unit.

name: wioIecTaskCycleTimeMin[1]
description: Minimum observed execution cycle time for this IEC task; the vendor MIB does not specify the unit.

name: wioIecTaskCycleTimeMax[1]
description: Maximum observed execution cycle time for this IEC task; the vendor MIB does not specify the unit.

name: wioIecTaskCycleTimeAvg[1]
description: Average observed execution cycle time for this IEC task; the vendor MIB does not specify the unit.

name: wioMaxConnections
description: Maximum number of Modbus connections supported by the controller.

name: wioFreeModbusSockets
description: Currently unused Modbus connection slots. A sustained value near zero indicates connection exhaustion.

name: wioModulCount
description: Number of I/O modules detected on the K-bus. An unexpected change can indicate a missing module or K-bus problem.
